repo_notes.content: Notes for VAY Sports Fest integration system

pages.title: Overview
pages.purpose: High-level introduction to the VAYSF Sports Fest management system: its purpose, three-tier architecture, key components, and how the major subsystems relate. Links to child pages for deeper coverage.

pages.title: Getting Started
pages.purpose: Installation prerequisites, environment setup (.env configuration), running tests in mock vs. live mode, and the daily-run workflow for operators.

pages.title: CLI Reference (main.py)
pages.purpose: Comprehensive reference for every sub-command exposed by middleware/main.py: sync, export-church-teams, build-schedule-workbook, solve-schedule, produce-schedule, generate-badges, check-consent, audit-team-groups, reset-season, import-approved-games, import-team-matchups, and maintenance utilities.

pages.title: Core Architecture
pages.purpose: Overview of the three-tier architecture (ChMeetings → Python Middleware → WordPress), data flow between tiers, key configuration constants, and the central Config class. Links to child pages for each tier.

pages.title: Configuration and Constants
pages.purpose: Deep dive into middleware/config.py: sport types, formats, approval statuses, fee tiers, field ID mappings (SF_FIELD_IDS, CHM_FIELDS), venue estimation constants, solver seeds, and environment variable validation.

pages.title: WordPress Plugin (VAYSF)
pages.purpose: Architecture of the plugins/vaysf WordPress plugin: database schema (sf_churches, sf_participants, sf_rosters, sf_validation_issues, sf_pool_advancement), REST API endpoints, admin dashboard, pastor approval workflow, insurance upload, shortcodes ([vaysf_live_schedule], [vaysf_advancement], [coordinator_score_entry]), and the event-day results workflow.

pages.title: ChMeetings API Connector
pages.purpose: How the middleware communicates with ChMeetings: authentication, pagination, rate-limit backoff (429 retries), person CRUD operations, group membership management, photo uploads, and the PERSON_PUT_EXCLUDE/PERSON_PUT_WRITABLE_FIELDS safety filters.

pages.title: WordPress REST Connector
pages.purpose: How the middleware communicates with the WordPress plugin REST API: participant CRUD, roster management, validation issue sync, approval token creation, email sending, retry/backoff logic, and the REST API controller classes (class-vaysf-rest-*.php).

pages.title: Data Synchronization
pages.purpose: Overview of the full sync pipeline: how data flows from ChMeetings through the middleware into WordPress and back. Links to child pages covering each sync subsystem.

pages.title: SyncManager and Participant Sync
pages.purpose: Detailed coverage of SyncManager orchestration and ParticipantSyncer: the full sync pipeline (mapping, status preservation, drift detection, membership integrity, validation, roster sync), approval status state machine, and the Pastor Approval workflow.

pages.title: Church and Group Management
pages.purpose: Church data sync from Excel (ChurchSyncer), group assignment logic (assign_people_to_church_team_groups), identity matching tiers, hydration engine, orphaned membership auditing, and the Lost-and-Found group fallback.

pages.title: Identity Drift and Consent Checking
pages.purpose: How the middleware detects hard vs. soft identity drift after approval, the membership-flip exploit prevention, consent checker (fuzzy matching of consent form exports to participants), and the consent-404 investigator for stale profile merges.

pages.title: Season Reset and Lifecycle Management
pages.purpose: The SeasonResetter utility: archiving custom fields to ChMeetings profile notes, clearing fields for the next season, idempotency checks, ChMeetings PUT full-replace constraints, and the season transition workflow documented in SEASON_TRANSITION.md.

pages.title: Validation Engine
pages.purpose: Overview of the three-layer validation framework (Individual, Team, Church) and how rules are loaded from JSON. Links to child pages for each layer and the doubles resolver.

pages.title: Individual and Team Validators
pages.purpose: IndividualValidator (age calculation, consent, photo, partner checks), TeamValidator (min team size, non-member limits, reciprocal partner matching), ChurchValidator (entry quotas), and the summer_2026.json ruleset structure.

pages.title: Doubles Resolver and Name Matching
pages.purpose: The canonical doubles resolver algorithm: two-phase partner matching (exact, unique candidate, reciprocal), UnresolvedRecord states (AmbiguousPartner, NonReciprocal, SelfPaired, PartnerNotFound), name normalization with parenthetical aliases, and stable entry_id generation.

pages.title: Schedule Diagnostics and Conflict Audit
pages.purpose: The schedule_diagnostics module: detecting shared-athlete conflicts in the produced schedule, primary vs. secondary overlap classification, and the Conflict-Audit report tab in the output workbook.

pages.title: Scheduling System
pages.purpose: Overview of the multi-stage scheduling pipeline: Layer 1 planning, approved-games import, Stage-A gym allocation, Stage-B CP-SAT solving, and production output. Links to child pages for each stage.

pages.title: Schedule Workbook Builder (Layer 1 Planning)
pages.purpose: ScheduleWorkbookBuilder class: generating the Schedule_Workbook Excel (Venue-Estimator, Pool-Assignment, Pod-Divisions, Court-Schedule-Sketch tabs), pool generation policies (2-game vs 3-game), serpentine fill, Bible Challenge no-repeat triplets, and the sidecar injection pattern into ChurchTeamsExporter.

pages.title: Gym Allocator (Stage A)
pages.purpose: The GymAllocator greedy pre-allocation: GymBlock and AllocationDecision data structures, scarcity-aware mode priority, gym selection heuristics (specialization, switch penalty, capacity), physical window fragmentation, and the venue_input.xlsx template.

pages.title: CP-SAT Solver (Stage B)
pages.purpose: The scheduler.py CP-SAT engine: pool decomposition strategy, solve order (BC → Soccer → Gym Core → Racquet), constraints C1–C7 (assignment, resource uniqueness, team uniqueness, cross-pool avoidance, court routing, minimum rest, multi-slot), six-tier lexicographic objective, pinned playoff slots, and determinism via fixed random seed.

pages.title: Schedule Contracts, Approved Games, and Output Production
pages.purpose: Pydantic-based schedule_contracts validation (input and output), the approved_games.py importer for operator-authored workbooks (main schedule, Badminton, Soccer, Table Tennis), match_schedule_overrides.py visual grid parser, manual_matchups.py team assignment import, schedule_publisher.py diff/protect logic, planning_tabs.py workbook generation, master_schedule.py manual override parsing, output_report.py Master-Schedule grid rendering, and the produce-schedule command.

pages.title: Reporting and Exports
pages.purpose: Overview of the reporting subsystem: church team Excel workbooks, multi-sport matrix, venue estimator, scoresheet generation, and badge generation. Links to child pages for each report type.

pages.title: Church Teams Exporter
pages.purpose: ChurchTeamsExporter class: data aggregation pipeline (ChMeetings + WordPress join), Excel workbook tabs (Summary, Contacts-Status, Roster, Validation-Issues, Multi-Sport-Matrix), athlete fee calculation with timezone normalization, reverse partner suggestion lookup, and the force-resend approval workflow.

pages.title: Athlete Badge Generation
pages.purpose: BadgeGenerator rendering pipeline (template, identity layer, QR block, dynamic event card stack), BadgeRunner orchestration (photo fetching with ChMeetings/WordPress fallback), SHA-256 fingerprinting for incremental renders, HMAC-based deterministic filenames, consent alert and minor status tags, font management, and badge hosting via WordPress REST API.

pages.title: Scoresheet Generation and Data Maintenance
pages.purpose: The scoresheets.py PDF generation pipeline (basketball, soccer, volleyball, bible-challenge), --stage and --game-key filters for playoff scoresheets, bible_verse_sets.json integration, the photo_repair utility for correcting mismatched or missing participant photos, the chrome_export_vaysf_forms.py script for scraping ChMeetings form exports via Chrome remote debugging, and the consent-404 investigator for resolving stale profile merge references.

pages.title: Event-Day Operations
pages.purpose: Overview of the WordPress-based event-day system: score entry, results desk, pool advancement, QF seeding, playoff preview, and the public-facing live schedule and advancement shortcodes. Links to child pages for each subsystem.

pages.title: Coordinator Score Entry and Results Desk
pages.purpose: The coordinator-score-entry dashboard (tabbed interface: needs/submitted/assigned/qf-setup), sport-specific score forms (simple, three_team, volleyball, placement), vaysf_persist_score_result transaction pipeline, result revision audit trail, scoresheet scan file vault, and the Results Desk manager interface for reviewing disputed scores and confirming pool advancement.

pages.title: Pool Progress, QF Seeding, and Playoff Advancement
pages.purpose: Pool standings calculation (W/L/diff/DoS tiebreaks for Basketball and Volleyball), head-to-head tiebreak resolution, coin-toss flip mechanism, cross-pool QF seeding (vaysf_results_desk_sort_pool_rankings), Bible Challenge Top-9 semifinal matchup assignment, playoff-preview builders, vaysf_apply_playoff_advancement_from_result automatic placeholder resolution, and the [vaysf_advancement] public shortcode.

pages.title: Testing Infrastructure
pages.purpose: Overview of the pytest-based test suite: mock vs. live vs. live-mutation modes, conftest fixtures, test data files, and the TEST_PLAN_V105 document. Links to child pages for each major test area.
